messages:
samuel-l: hi team, day 3 here. i'm trying to map who owns the repo 'redwood-serving' and the surface areas for alerts / rollback authority. docs point to an org chart but still fuzzy. who do i ask about: 1) service owner for runtime and model routing, 2) who can approve emergency rollbacks, and 3) who to loop in for data access requests (metrics/events)?
mia-eng: hey @samuel-l — repo ownership is split: runtime infra = eng-platform (me), model-routing logic = ml-infra (olga owns the feature flag), and product-facing API config = product infra (olga-plat). for emergencies: eng-sre has rollback authority during incidents.
peggy-ops: +1. during incidents SRE will coordinate rollback + mitigation. we keep a runbook per service: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/redwood-serving (read-only). if you9re unsure, open an incident channel using /incident create and SRE will triage.
oncall-bot: To create an incident channel run: `/incident create "redwood-serving" severity=sev2 reporter=@samuel-l` — follow prompts. Incident protocol: sev1 phone tree, sev2 slack triage + follow-up.
olga-plat: hi @samuel-l — for change approvals outside scheduled deploy windows, platform PMs and service owners are needed. If you need to push a hotfix, open a PR with description and tag @olga-plat and @mia-eng. For rollbacks, include the revert PR link and CI run id.
nate-sec: security/data access: metrics DB access requests go through the data-access workflow (ticketing queue "DATA"), include JIRA: DATA-ACCESS, purpose, and retention period. Sensitive query access needs an approved DPA sign-off. For quick read-only access to agg metrics, ask for "metrics_ro" role and include the dataset id.
hr-liaison: FYI new hires should finish the security training by day 5 to reduce approval delays. contact me if training enrollment failed.
samuel-l: thanks all — quick clarifying Qs: (a) who is the canonical contact for model-routing flags (i want to test a toggle), and (b) if i open an incident channel, should i also @olga-plat or wait for SRE to loop product in?
mia-eng: canonical for model-routing flags is @olga-plat (she owns the feature-flag registry). if it's just a dev toggle for your sandbox, you can test in staging and ping olga. For incidents: create the incident channel and SRE will page product as needed, but if it's product-impacting and you know product owners, feel free to ping them immediately.
olga-plat: yep, flag owner here. if you need a toggle in staging i can create one-scoped flag for you (ttl 24h). DM me flag name & use-case.
peggy-ops: also adding note: escalation path summary = owner -> oncall SRE -> platform lead -> CTO for cross-regional outages. we keep this in the org escalation matrix: https://redwood.internal/esc-proc (internal).
samuel-l: perfect—opening the DATA-ACCESS ticket now and will DM @olga-plat for the staging flag. appreciate the quick map! :tada:
